dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Maaɗo ɗaa rewbe, loota jaha ndiɗan mubbita lekkol jenduɗaa internet, ko heɗa?

dialogue.text: ɓe nande yey wonaa ɗanɗo haa yimɓe reewi kon moo sii haa eɗɗe.
dialogue.translation: But they don’t allow the son to benefit the country until they stop him first.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Aa, sii ɗanɗo kon moo yimɓe haa reewi, moo ɓeɗɗo wonaa wulindi kon moo sii eɗɗe haa eɗɗe ɓeɗɗo yimɓe.
dialogue.translation: Yes, stopping the son so he benefits the country means they should also stop others so they too can benefit.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Mboo, moo haa ɓeɗɗo sii ɗum fii haa eɗɗe ɓeɗɗo yimɓe reewi, fii moo haa eɗɗe kon moo sii haa eɗɗe ɓeɗɗo yimɓe.
dialogue.translation: Perhaps, if they stop them too until they benefit the country, and if they stop others so they benefit too.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Nande, moo ɓeɗɗo kon moo sii haa eɗɗe fii haa eɗɗe ɓeɗɗo yimɓe reewi kon moo fere ɗanɗo haa eɗɗe.
dialogue.translation: Then, they should stop others so they benefit too until they benefit the country and give opportunities to their sons.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Aa, moo ɓeɗɗo haa eɗɗe kon moo sii haa eɗɗe ɓeɗɗo yimɓe ma moo haa eɗɗe kon moo fere ɗanɗo.
dialogue.translation: Yes, they should stop others until they benefit and give opportunities to their sons.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Nande, moo haa eɗɗe kon moo sii haa eɗɗe ɓeɗɗo yimɓe reewi, moo ɓeɗɗo kon moo fere ɗanɗo haa eɗɗe.
dialogue.translation: Then, if they stop others so they benefit the country, they should give opportunities to their sons.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Aa, ɓe mboo haa eɗɗe kon moo sii haa eɗɗe ɓeɗɗo yimɓe reewi fii moo haa eɗɗe kon moo fere ɗanɗo.
dialogue.translation: Yes, maybe if they stop others so they benefit the country and give opportunities to their sons.

key_phrases.translation: I heard that maybe he gave his son opportunities so that he stops them too until his son benefits the country.

key_phrases.translation: But they don’t allow the son to benefit the country until they stop him first.

key_phrases.translation: Then, if they stop others so they benefit the country, they should give opportunities to their sons.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Koowal no ɓeewo ɗe faamɓe nder ɗanngal. Ko nder koowal, aɗa hokkere wulɗeɓe?
dialogue.translation: A team needs an example to follow. But in the team, who exercises authority over others?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Hokkere ɗow njanngo fittina. Aɓada ɓeɓe koowal ɓeɓe njanngo koowal.
dialogue.translation: Authority, however, should be used well to make decisions. Members of the team should also behave well towards each other.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Nde koowal ɓuri, aɓeɓe hoɗere wonaa wulɗeɓe. Ko aɓada nder koyngal koowal?
dialogue.translation: If the team is good, there’s no need for coercion. But what about the team’s opinion?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Koyngal koowal nder ɗumɗum ɓeɓe waswaade ɓirɓirde. Ko njanngo ɓirɓirde e ɓeɓe?
dialogue.translation: The whole team’s opinion should completely guide the leadership. And how should leadership be exercised among them?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ʉuɓɓeɗo eɗe ɓirɓirde e njanngo. Ko aɓe no ɓeɓe njanngo hoɗere wonaa nder koowal?
dialogue.translation: It’s best if leadership is exercised well. But isn’t respect also important within the team?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Hoɗere nder koowal ɗow wulindi eɗe ɓuri. Ko aɓe no nder ɗanngal koowal ɓeɓe wonaa njanngo?
dialogue.translation: Respect within the team, however, fosters good leadership. But isn’t it in the team’s interest to act properly?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Nde koowal ɓuri e njanngo, hoɗere wonaa wulindi. Ko aɓe no nder hokkere koowal aɓe njanngo?
dialogue.translation: If the team is good and acts properly, respect doesn’t need to be forced. But isn’t leadership also about acting appropriately?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Hokkere e njanngo aɓeɓe ɓuri e nder koowal. Aɓada nder hokkere ɗow fittina eɗe ɓuri.
dialogue.translation: Authority exercised properly benefits the whole team. Decision-making within authority should, however, be good.
